column1: # Issue #117: committed cells that native-script decline cues move from incorrect to refused.
# Before #117 the cue list was English, so a decline written in Hebrew, Punjabi, Hindi, Arabic or
# Greek was scored as a wrong answer. Every row here goes incorrect -> refused and only the outcome
# field changes. The committed scores.jsonl are not rewritten (final-contract item; see the issue).
# A cell is (folder, 0-based row in answers.jsonl, question_id): a committed file can hold one
# question twice, so the question id alone is not unique.
# The Devanagari avagraha fold removed 5 Hindi cells from this list: each declines, then quotes the
# verse with चाचारो-style spelling. The quote now counts as contained, so the cell scores correct and
# the decline cue no longer moves it (listed in devanagari_avagraha_movers.tsv). 787 rows.
